stops.name: Piz Bernina
stops.quote: Piz Bernina stands out due to its almost freestanding nature and as a result also offers unique far-reaching views from its summit.

stops.name: Biancograt
stops.quote: You'll fly close to Piz Bernina, the Biancograt, and past glaciers.
stops.english: You'll fly close to Piz Bernina, the Biancograt, and past glaciers.

stops.name: Bernina Massif
stops.quote: During the Bernina Standard Helicopter Round Flight, you'll discover the glacier world of the Bernina Massif.
stops.english: During the Bernina Standard Helicopter Round Flight, you'll discover the glacier world of the Bernina Massif.

stops.name: Upper Engadine
stops.quote: The return flight over the lake landscape of the Upper Engadine completes your flying experience.
stops.english: The return flight over the lake landscape of the Upper Engadine completes your flying experience.

stops.name: Poschiavo
stops.quote: On the Bernina Express you travel from the glaciers of the Engadine to an ice cream cone at the Mediterranean piazza of Poschiavo with many trail highlights in between.
stops.english: On the Bernina Express you travel from the glaciers of the Engadine to an ice cream cone at the Mediterranean piazza of Poschiavo with many trail highlights in between.

stops.name: Valposchiavo
stops.quote: A journey on the Bernina Herb Express to Le Prese is a chance for passengers to experience the UNESCO World Heritage Site up close and immerse themselves in the world of herbs in Valposchiavo.
stops.english: A journey on the Bernina Herb Express to Le Prese is a chance for passengers to experience the UNESCO World Heritage Site up close and immerse themselves in the world of herbs in Valposchiavo.

stops.name: La Gatta winery
stops.quote: The highlight is a visit to the La Gatta winery, where you can enjoy a local lunch paired with matching wines.
stops.english: The highlight is a visit to the La Gatta winery, where you can enjoy a local lunch paired with matching wines.
